title: Concept: Go module required with no version
description: go.mod declares a `require` line whose version is empty, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Go resolves the missing version to the latest release at build time, so the module that compiles is decided by the proxy, not the file.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: Go resolves the missing version to the latest release at build time, so the module that compiles is decided by the proxy, not the file.
